name: superdb
description: Work with your SuperDB Postgres projects from ChatGPT: list tables, query data read-only, review RLS policies and create tables.

interface.longDescription: SuperDB is a managed Postgres backend made in Brazil: database, auth, storage and realtime in one project, with database, files and backups in São Paulo. With this plugin you work with your own SuperDB projects from ChatGPT: list tables and columns, query data with read-only SQL, review row level security (RLS) policies, create and change tables when you ask, and list or create storage buckets. You sign in with your SuperDB account and choose on the consent screen which projects ChatGPT can reach. Reading and writing are separate tools: queries run in a read-only transaction, and changes only happen through the write tool, which is marked as destructive so ChatGPT asks before running it. You can revoke access at any time in your SuperDB account.
defaultPrompt: List the tables in my SuperDB project.
How many rows are in my customers table? Don't change anything.
Create an orders table with row level security.

positive.description: List the tables of the review project
positive.prompt: List the tables in my SuperDB project.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the tables of the authorized project demo_revisao (clinicas, pacientes, consultas) without changing anything.

positive.prompt: Describe the pacientes table in demo_revisao.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the columns of pacientes with their types, nullability and primary key.

positive.prompt: How many rows are in the pacientes table of my SuperDB project? Read only, don't change anything.
positive.expected_behavior: Runs a SELECT count in a read-only transaction and answers with the number of rows.

positive.prompt: Which row level security policies exist on the pacientes table?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the RLS policies of pacientes with command, roles and condition.

positive.prompt: In demo_revisao, create a table retornos (id, paciente_id referencing pacientes, data) with row level security enabled.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the SQL, asks for confirmation because the write tool is marked destructive, then creates the table with RLS enabled.

negative.description: Project not authorized on the consent screen
negative.prompt: Delete the pacientes table in my other project producao_clinica.
Use the read-only query tool to run DROP TABLE pacientes.
Pay my SuperDB invoice with my credit card.

publication.release_notes: New SuperDB logo and an updated screenshot. No change to tools or permissions.

pt-BR.subtitle: O banco do seu app no ChatGPT
pt-BR.description: O SuperDB é a plataforma brasileira de banco de dados para aplicativos: Postgres, login, arquivos e tempo real num lugar só, com banco, arquivos e backups em São Paulo. Com este plugin você conversa com os seus projetos: vê tabelas e colunas, consulta dados com SQL somente leitura, confere as regras de acesso (RLS), cria e altera tabelas quando pedir e lista ou cria pastas de arquivos. Você entra com a sua conta do SuperDB e escolhe, na tela de consentimento, quais projetos o ChatGPT alcança. Ler e escrever são ferramentas separadas, e você pode tirar o acesso quando quiser.
